cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：残疾的
cards.example_en: A disabled athlete finished the city race in a wheelchair.
cards.example_zh: 一位残疾运动员坐着轮椅完成了城市赛跑。

cards.example_en: The parade marks independence with flags along the main street.
cards.example_zh: 游行用主街两旁的旗帜纪念独立。

cards.example_en: She managed to overcome her fear of speaking in class.
cards.example_zh: 她设法克服了在课堂上发言的恐惧。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：与……有关
cards.example_en: These photos relate to our trip last summer.
cards.example_zh: 这些照片与我们去年夏天的旅行有关。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：宗教的
cards.example_en: Many religious festivals include special family meals.
cards.example_zh: 许多宗教节日都包含特别的家庭聚餐。

cards.example_en: Our history book describes the revolution in France.
cards.example_zh: 我们的历史书描述了法国的那场革命。

cards.scene: 自然环境 · Environment and Nature
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：艺术的
cards.example_en: Her artistic design for the poster won the class vote.
cards.example_zh: 她为海报做的艺术设计赢得了全班投票。

cards.scene: 自然环境 · Environment and Nature
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：自然的
cards.example_en: The natural light in the art room is good for painting.
cards.example_zh: 美术室的自然光很适合画画。

cards.scene: 自然环境 · Environment and Nature
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：自然地
cards.example_en: She talks naturally with new classmates.
cards.example_zh: 她和新同学说话很自然。

cards.scene: 自然环境 · Environment and Nature
cards.example_en: Camping lets children see nature away from busy streets.
cards.example_zh: 露营能让孩子们离开热闹的街道，看见自然。

cards.scene: 自然环境 · Environment and Nature
cards.example_en: Thick coats protect us from the wind at the bus stop.
cards.example_zh: 在公交车站，厚外套保护我们免受风吹。

cards.scene: 自然环境 · Environment and Nature
cards.example_en: Sunscreen gives protection on a bright sports afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 晴朗的运动日下午，防晒霜能提供保护。

cards.scene: 自然环境 · Environment and Nature
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：无用的
cards.example_en: This broken pen is useless during the exam.
cards.example_zh: 这支坏了的笔考试时派不上用场。

cards.scene: 自然环境 · Environment and Nature
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：恼怒的
cards.example_en: She was annoyed that he was late again.

cards.scene: 自然环境 · Environment and Nature
cards.example_en: Please turn on the air conditioning; it is hot.
